summary: This wiki-shaped variant is one concrete form of the broader Companion App comprehension product.

items.text: Use the broader comprehension-product pattern when the cognitive interface grows beyond a wiki into graphs, canvases or other navigable surfaces.

See Continuous Two-Way Alignment for the related use case or counterpoint: Continuously reconcile system artifacts and their human-facing companion in both directions so neither machine progress nor human knowledge becomes an isolated, drifting truth.

See On-the-Fly Generated UIs (Usually Cached) for the related use case or counterpoint: Generate an interface from the artifact it fronts, cache and version the result against those inputs, and regenerate it when they change.

See Sidecar Metadata for the related use case or counterpoint: Put rich artifact metadata in predictably named companion files beside the artifact so people and agents can see, diff and discover it without opening the content.
See Versioned Prompt Text for the related use case or counterpoint: Keep prompts as plain files in the code repository, and link every model call to the exact prompt version that produced it.
